fact: The Ministry of Innovation and Technology says the Digital Ethiopia 2030 strategy is grounded in digital sovereignty, with a sovereign national cloud and strict enforcement of data sovereignty laws as its backbone.

The government is developing a centralised national data cloud at the Ethiopian Artificial Intelligence Institute, which Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed said will exceed the combined capacity of data centres now run by public institutions.
The deck says Fayda uses the local government cloud (gCloud) and that software development is decoupled from the cloud provider on an on-premises cloud.
State Minister Solomon Soka said Ethiopia aims to host its national data, projected at about 600 petabytes by 2030, within its own digital infrastructure under the Digital Ethiopia 2030 strategy.
